quota_signal_source: Claude Desktop ~/Library/Logs/Claude/main.log exact current-session limit/reset text; ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/plan-usage-history.json five-hour utilization samples; Claude Desktop Accessibility UI usage popup
user_action_required: Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility, add and enable /Volumes/移动硬盘（512G）/ReSETP/tools/claude_quota_watchdog/ReSETP Claude Quota Watchdog Helper.app, then run python3 tools/claude_quota_watchdog/claude_quota_watchdog.py --test-wake. Start the daemon only if that self-test reports PASS.
